Rule.name: fixed-feb-10
Rule.comment: Proclaimed by the United Nations General Assembly in 2018 (resolution 73/251) and first observed on 10 February 2019, to raise awareness of the nutritional benefits of pulses.

Rule.name: fixed-may-21
Rule.comment: Observed by the United Nations on 21 May and led by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), recognizing tea's cultural heritage, health benefits, economic importance, and sustainable production.

Rule.name: fixed-jun-07
Rule.comment: Established by the United Nations General Assembly in 2018 (resolution 73/250) and first observed on 7 June 2019. Co-sponsored by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the World Health Organization (WHO).

Rule.name: weekday-1st-fri-aug
Rule.comment: An informal global beer culture observance founded in Santa Cruz, California, and now generally observed on the first Friday in August.

Rule.name: fixed-oct-01
Rule.comment: A global coffee-sector observance promoted by the International Coffee Organization and coffee associations, celebrating coffee culture and raising awareness of the livelihoods of coffee producers.

Rule.name: fixed-oct-01
Rule.comment: Established in 1977 by the North American Vegetarian Society and endorsed by the International Vegetarian Union in 1978, to promote the joy, compassion, and life-enhancing possibilities of vegetarianism.

Rule.name: fixed-oct-16
Rule.comment: Established by the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in 1979 and first observed on 16 October 1981. The date marks the founding of the FAO in 1945.

Rule.name: fixed-nov-01
Rule.comment: Established in 1994 by the Vegan Society to mark the organization's 50th anniversary and to celebrate veganism worldwide.
